title: Clip: through geometry at (0,145)
expected: The player body never passes through or overlaps solid level geometry.
suspects: res://player/player.gd: movement code that sets position directly instead of using move_and_slide()

plain.headline: The player went through solid ground after a hard landing at (0, 145).
plain.what_happened: The player's body moved into solid level geometry instead of stopping on it.
plain.how_to_see_it: Start the level from spawn point 8, then wait 0.6 s. Or press Replay in game.
plain.why_it_matters: Players can get stuck inside the level or fall through it.
